const entries = listDir("src");
console.log(entries);
const tree = shell("find src -type f -print | sort && printf '\\n-- counts --\\n' && find src -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 wc -l");
console.log(tree.output);
return { exitCode: tree.exitCode, root: listDir() };


const files = shell("find src -type f -print | sort");
if (files.exitCode !== 0) return { error: "Could not list src files", output: files.output };

const paths = files.output.trim().split("\n").filter(Boolean);
const lines = paths.map((path) => {
  const content = readTextFile(path);
  const count = content.length === 0 ? 0 : content.split("\n").length - (content.endsWith("\n") ? 1 : 0);
  return `- ${path.slice(4)} (${count} lines)`;
});
writeFile("MANIFEST.md", lines.join("\n") + "\n");

const manifest = readTextFile("MANIFEST.md");
const listing = shell("ls -la");
console.log(listing.output);

if (listing.exitCode !== 0) return { error: "ls -la failed", output: listing.output };
if (!listDir().some((entry) => entry.kind === "file" && entry.name === "MANIFEST.md")) {
  return { error: "MANIFEST.md was not found after writing" };
}
if (manifest !== lines.join("\n") + "\n") {
  return { error: "MANIFEST.md verification failed" };
}

finish(`Created MANIFEST.md listing all ${paths.length} files under src, sorted by name with line counts, and confirmed it exists with ls -la.`);
